title: Characters
deletedEmpty: Nothing deleted. A deleted hero is archived here first and can be restored.
switchBody: Leave the game now and start {name}? The current hero is saved.
deleteBody1: {name} is archived first: the save and its saved state are copied, checked byte for byte, and only then removed.
deleteBody2: The archive stays on this PC in characters-archive/{name}/ and is never cleaned up. Restore it from Deleted below, any time.
deleteActive: The hero in the game is never deleted. Switch to another hero first, then delete {name}.
restoreBody: Restore {name} ({meta})? The save and its saved state come back. It is not started: use Switch to play it.
nameHint: {min} to {max} letters, and one hyphen or underscore at most, never first or last.
nameTooShort: Too short: a name has {min} to {max} letters.
nameTooLong: Too long: a name has {min} to {max} letters.
nameChars: Letters only, plus one hyphen or underscore.
nameSep: One hyphen or underscore at most, and not at the start or the end.
nameTaken: A hero called {name} already exists (names ignore capitals).
rulesMissing: The bot did not send its class list, so a new hero cannot be made from here.
stripSwitch: Switching to {to}... {from} is saved and the game is leaving.
stripCreate: Creating {to}... the game is leaving and the new hero starts.
stripWait: Starting {to}... waiting for the bot to come back.
stripFail: The change to {to} did not finish. Check the game and the bot, then look at the list again.
startedSwitch: Switching to {name}: the game leaves now.
startedCreate: Creating {name}: it shows in the list after its first save.
doneDelete: {name} is deleted. Archived as {archive}; restore it from Deleted.
doneRestore: {name} is back in the list. Switch to it to play.
gone: The bot said it was done, but {name} is still listed. Look at the list before trying again.
missing: The bot said it was done, but {name} is not in the list. Look at the list before trying again.
errOffTitle: Character management needs the bot under its own supervisor
errOffBody: This bot was not started with the character desk, so it cannot list or change heroes. Start it as described in docs/charselect.md (Friends' machines).
errNoSaveBody: The save folder does not exist until the first save. Play a minute, then try again.
errNoAnswerBody: The bot did not answer. It may be starting or stopped; try again in a moment.
errOtherTitle: The list could not be read
emptyBody: The save folder holds no characters yet. Create one to begin.
noAnswer: No answer from the bot. Nothing was changed; look at the list and try again.

refusals.bad_name: That name is not allowed. Use letters, one hyphen or underscore at most.
refusals.confirm_mismatch: The typed name does not match. Nothing was deleted.
refusals.bad_archive: That archive is not known. Nothing was restored.
refusals.body: The request was not understood. Nothing was changed.
refusals.not_found: That hero is not in the save folder any more. The list is up to date now.
refusals.measured_run: A measured run is in progress, so heroes are never changed. Nothing was changed.
refusals.switch_in_progress: A switch is already under way. Wait until it is done.
refusals.no_supervisor: Switching needs the bot to run under its supervisor. Nothing was changed.
refusals.active: That hero is playing now. Switch to another hero first.
refusals.damaged: That save is damaged, so it cannot be played. It can still be archived with Delete.
refusals.corrupt: That save failed its check, so it was not started. Nothing was changed.
refusals.dead_hardcore: That hardcore hero has died and cannot be played.
refusals.exists: A hero with that name already exists. Nothing was changed.
refusals.save_failed: The game did not save, so nothing was changed. The hero keeps playing.
refusals.delete_failed: The delete did not finish. Look at the list and the archive before trying again.
refusals.restore_failed: The restore did not finish. Look at the list before trying again.
refusals.intent_failed: The bot could not start the switch. Nothing was changed.
refusals.list_failed: The list could not be read. Try again in a moment.
refusals.unsupported: This bot cannot do that yet.
refusals.off: Character management needs the bot under its own supervisor.
refusals.no_save_dir: The save folder does not exist yet. The first save creates it.
refusals.origin: This page is not allowed to change heroes from here.
refusals.token: You are not signed in for changes. Open the page from the watch screen.
refusals.method: The request was not understood. Nothing was changed.
refusals.content-type: The request was not understood. Nothing was changed.
